high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the artist Dua Lipa. The post was made one day prior to the screenshot being taken, as indicated by the timestamp "1d" at the top of the post. The main focus is on Dua Lipa, who is standing in front of a crowd. She appears to be interacting with her fans. The crowd consists of numerous people, many of whom are holding up their phones to take pictures or videos of her. Some fans are holding signs, including one that reads "FOR ONE HUG." Dua
